## About me

My academic background is in Economics. I received both my Bachelor's and Master's degrees from the [University of Rome Tor Vergata (Italy)](https://economia.uniroma2.it), and a Master of Science in Economics & Finance from the [University of Navarre (Spain)](https://www.unav.edu/web/landings/master-en-economia-y-finanzas?utm_medium=cpc&utm_source=google&utm_campaign=feco_mef2425&gad_source=1&gclid=CjwKCAjwgdayBhBQEiwAXhMxtpDVwJDBNrwIUgddyAGQgiTA_hu_deIbJzuWys7hgCi3PRFNJi27LxoCvZ8QAvD_BwE). 

My research interests lie broadly in the field of empirical Political Economy. To date, my focus is on: 
<ol>
  <li> The impact of different institutional arrangements on individual behaviors and social norms; </li>
  <li> Populism, including its causes, measurement, and effects on socio-economic institutions;</li>
  <li> Democratic backsliding and illiberalism within the public administration. </li>
</ol>

Besides my research, I'm a data visualization and programming enthusiast.

If you would like to get in touch, feel free to reach out via [email](mailto:and.celico@gmail.com)!
